subject: Microburst commit adjustment + co-term pathway
messages:
From: Elena Morris <elena@latticeai.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
Cc: Procurement <procurement@latticeai.com>
Date: Wed, 25 Aug 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: mid-contract capacity increase + co-term

Hi Vivek,

Quick note from Lattice's side — we've seen an unexpected spike in inference usage over the last month tied to a new feature rollout. We're looking to increase our committed capacity by ~175% effective immediately and would like that increase to co-term with our existing renewal date (2028-02-01).

Key asks:
- Can you provide 1) a quick price for an immediate top-up pro-rated through 2/1/28 and 2) an option to annualize that top-up (12 months) for a blended rate?
- Any guidance on discounts if we commit to the elevated level for 12 months vs. short-term top-up?
- Procurement will need a draft PO and estimated invoice timing.

Ravi in procurement is copied — they'd like to move quickly this week.

Thanks,
Elena

--
Elena Morris
Head of ML Ops, Lattice AI
elena@latticeai.com
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
To: Elena Morris <elena@latticeai.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 25 Aug 2027 10:47:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: mid-contract capacity increase + co-term

Elena — thanks for the context and the heads-up. We can support two clean paths; attaching a quick sketch (redwood_quick_quote_v1.pdf) as a starting point. High level:

Option A — Immediate top-up (pro-rata to 2028-02-01):
- Add 175% capacity now, charge pro-rata for remainder of contract term.
- No long-term commitment beyond 2/1/28; pricing = published top-up rate with a 3% short-term uplift.

Option B — Annualize the uplift (preferred for unit economics):
- Convert the uplift into a 12-month commitment starting now; co-term on 2/1/28 would be handled by annualizing price to match a 12-month cadence (we’ll align billing).
- For a 12-month elevated commit we can offer a 10% discount vs. list top-up rates (this reflects reserved capacity economics).

A few operational items we’ll need:
- Confirm whether Lattice prefers invoice now (pro-rated) vs. invoice on a start-of-period monthly schedule.
- PO draft (lattice_po_draft.pdf) or a quick confirmation email will get the billing cycle started.

Ben — can you run the exact math on the blended 12-month path and the pro-rata numbers? I put a placeholder in the attached.

Elena — I’ll follow up with a formal quote and MAP (mutual_action_plan) once Ben confirms numbers.

Best,
Vivek

--
Vivek Kulkarni
Head of Sales, Redwood Inference
vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>
Cc: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 26 Aug 2027 08:34:00 -0700
Subject: Internal: Lattice mid-contract uplift math (need numbers)

Team — copying the external ask below. Need a tidy breakdown by EOD so we can give procurement a clean comparison (pro-rata vs annualize). Please include:
1) Monthly token unit economics at current consumption, projected at +175%
2) Pro-rata charge from 8/25/27 -> 2/1/28 (days basis)
3) Blended 12-month annualized spend and list price vs. 10% discounted price
4) Invoice timing options (immediate vs month-start) and any impact on SLA or commit credit terms

I started a calc (pricing_calc_vk.xlsx) — Ben, Naomi, if you can update with SE inputs and margin impact that would be great.

Quote back with two versions: (A) fastest-approve (B) lower-cost annualized.

Thanks,
Vivek
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>, Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>
Cc: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 26 Aug 2027 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Internal: Lattice mid-contract uplift math (need numbers)

Quick reply — ran two scenarios in the calc:

Scenario 1 (Pro-rata top-up):
- Pro-rated charge through 2/1/28 = $42,800 (one-time). This uses current published top-up rate + 3% short-term uplift.
- Invoiced immediately upon PO receipt. No change to SLA or credits.

Scenario 2 (Annualized elevated commit):
- Annualized 12-month effective spend = $382,000. With a 10% commitment discount = $343,800/year.
- If they accept the 12-month annualized path we can offer a 60-day accelerated invoice option (to help Lattice with forecast) but we need PO confirmation.

Alternative play (voucher fusion):
- Convert the top-up into a voucher pool (non-expiring for 12 months) for $360k with a 7% discount instead of co-terming complexity; that avoids mid-contract amendment complexity on legal but gets them better unit economics now.

I attached the numbers in the sheet and highlighted where margin sits. My recommendation: present both A (fast pro-rata) and B (annualize with 10%) — and offer voucher play as a third optional route if legal timeline is a blocker.

Ben
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
To: Elena Morris <elena@latticeai.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 27 Aug 2027 09:18:00 -0700
Subject: Lattice: formalized options + MAP

Elena — thanks for the patience. Attached are two formalized options and a short MAP to outline timelines and owners (redwood_topup_quote_v2.pdf, mutual_action_plan.xlsx). Summary:

Option A — Fast Pro-rata Top-up (recommended if procurement needs immediate capacity)
- One-time pro-rated charge through 2028-02-01: $42,800.
- Invoiced on receipt of PO. No term change; usage above commit billed at standard overage rates thereafter.
- Implementation: we can turn on capacity within 24 hours of PO.

Option B — Annualize Elevated Commit (better unit economics)
- Convert uplift to a 12-month elevated commit: list = $382,000/yr. Redwood 10% discount = $343,800/yr.
- Co-term handling: we’ll align billing cadence so the elevated commit amortizes to match the 2/1/28 co-term; a short amendment will be executed but annual billing simplifies forecasting.
- Invoice options: monthly, or accelerated 60-day invoice (requested by you) — note accelerated invoice helps Lattice cashflow but accelerates Redwood recognition.

Optional C — Voucher pool (legal-light alternative)
- $360k voucher pool, 12-month validity, 7% discount equivalent. No contract amendment; simple PO and invoice.

Next steps proposed:
- Choose option A/B/C and confirm preferred invoice timing.
- Procurement to send PO draft (we can accept Lattice PO template).
- Redwood to issue invoice and activation within 24 business hours for Option A, 3-5 business days for B/C depending on amendment/legal time.

Looping Naomi on billing and Jordan on contract amendment path.

Best,
Vivek

--
Vivek Kulkarni
Head of Sales, Redwood Inference
From: Elena Morris <elena@latticeai.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>

Subject: Re: Lattice: formalized options + MAP

Vivek — thanks, that is clean. Procurement prefers Option A for speed but would like invoice dated next Monday and activation the same day the PO lands. They also asked for a one-line SLA escalation clause to be added to the amendment (coverage details already acceptable). I attached a PO draft (lattice_po_draft.pdf) — legal will triage the amendment; procurement says they can accept a short amendment but would prefer voucher if legal delays are expected.

We'll confirm final sign-off by EOD Monday.

Appreciate the quick turnaround.
Elena
